title: 第19章 被针对的昭杺柠第18章 涂辞珩的深情告白
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
昭杺柠听见蓝莘这句话就不高兴了。
什么叫带上她就是拖累？
她还担心钟离珟8星实力打不过10星妖族，因为天道姻缘同生共死的原因，害她跟着一起死呢。
“小师叔。”蓝莘急忙忙说着：“既然归云客栈目前安全，要不将她留在客栈吧，这样您出去寻找大妖，也没后顾之忧。”
“在归云客栈里面……”蓝莘说着瞥了昭杺柠一眼，带着不情不愿的口吻：“弟子也能保护她。”
“看出你的勉强了，不需要你保护。”昭杺柠忍不了怼了回去。
这一刻，她突然想起昨天爬问剑峰时，突然感到后背投来的那道充满恶意的目光来自哪里。
当时就蓝莘站在那里，也只可能是蓝莘。
只不过昭杺柠回头时蓝莘又躲了起来。
如果说，昨天第一次相见，蓝莘在面对昭杺柠和钟离珟两人时，就只跟钟离珟对话，故意无视昭杺柠。
那么在今天，蓝莘对昭杺柠的存在有意见，是毫不掩藏的。
“呵呵，我堂堂问剑峰亲传弟子，好歹也是4星实力，来保护你一个毫无星级修炼天赋的凡人，可不是勉强吗。”蓝莘讥讽道。
她抱剑环胸，眼中全然是对昭杺柠的针对。
“蓝师姐。”一旁孙筘流忍不住低声提醒：“你少说点，她是小师婶啊。”
“那又怎样？没实力还跟着来归云城，不就是拖后腿吗。”蓝莘火力全开：“我真是同情小师叔，被你这么一个凡人绑定了天道姻缘。”
没想到才见面两次，可以说素不相识。
这蓝莘却如此针对自己，昭杺柠气得想往她脸上丢表情包，一旁钟离珟沉声呵斥：“够了。”
“目无长辈，这就是你身为问天宗弟子的教养？”钟离珟沉眸看向蓝莘：“你今日所言，等回问天宗我会如实告诉你的师尊唐长老。”
“弟子蓝莘，你今日先在归云客栈禁足，待本尊查探归云城妖族后，再视情况解除禁足。”钟离珟话音不容拒绝：“自己领罚。”
“小师叔……”没想到是自己被罚的蓝莘气绿了一张脸。

她还想要说什么，钟离珟已经拉着昭杺柠出了归云客栈。
“蓝师妹，请吧。”一旁万有乾监督着蓝莘禁足。
一边被万有乾催促，蓝莘不满抱怨：“我又没说错，这一次10星大妖，我们都帮不上忙，那昭杺柠一个凡人，可不就是拖累。”
【宿主，那个蓝莘很针对你啊，好像是因为钟离珟才针对你的】
“对啊，所以钟离珟给我引来的敌人，那么蓝莘对我的针对可以给我加积分吗？”昭杺柠不甚在意地询问。
【宿主，必须是钟离珟本人对你的仇恨才能加积分】
【还有宿主你能不能搞清楚重点啊，蓝莘是因为钟离珟针对你的，你说蓝莘是不是钟离珟的烂桃花？】
听见系统这带有引导的怀疑，昭杺柠冷笑：“你眼瞎啊，她能是什么烂桃花，她纯恨。”
【啊？她恨谁啊？因为你是钟离珟未婚妻，所以她恨你吗？】
“我都说了，她纯恨，既恨我，也恨钟离珟。”昭杺柠笃定。
虽然不知道蓝莘为什么恨自己，但从刚刚蓝莘对自己的针对，昭杺柠明显感受到蓝莘对她的恨意像是想要杀了她。
而且，昭杺柠不光感受到蓝莘对自己的针对，还察觉到蓝莘对钟离珟的针对和恨意。
content_en:
Zhao Hao Ning was not happy when she heard Lan Xin's words.
What do you mean bringing her with you is a drag?
She was also worried that Zhong Lizou's 8-star strength would not be able to defeat the 10-star demon clan, and she would die with him because of the destiny of marriage.
"Uncle Junior." Lan Xin said hurriedly: "Since Guiyun Inn is safe now, why not leave her at the inn, so that you don't have to worry about anything when you go out to look for the big demon."
"Inside Guiyun Inn..." Lan Xin glanced at Zhao Hao Ning as she spoke, and said in a reluctant tone, "Disciples can also protect her."
"I can see your reluctance. I don't need your protection." Zhao Hao Ning couldn't bear to fight back.
At this moment, she suddenly remembered the source of the malicious gaze cast from her back yesterday when she climbed Wenjian Peak.
Lan Xin was standing there at that time, and it could only be Lan Xin.
But when Zhao Haoning turned around, Lan Xin hid again.
If we say that they met for the first time yesterday, when Lan Xin faced Zhao Hao Ning and Zhong Lizuo, she only talked to Zhong Lizuo and deliberately ignored Zhao Hao Ning.
So today, Lan Xin made no secret of her objections to Zhao Hao Ning's existence.
"Haha, I ask you, I am a direct disciple of Jianfeng. After all, I am a 4-star warrior. Isn't it difficult to protect you, a mortal with no star-level cultivation talent?" Lan Xin said sarcastically.
She hugged her sword across her chest, her eyes completely aimed at Zhao Hao Ning.
"Senior Sister Lan." Sun Jinliu couldn't help but remind her in a low voice: "Stop talking, she is my junior aunt."
"So what? If you follow me back to Yuncheng even if you don't have the strength, isn't it just holding you back?" Lan Xin said with full force: "I really sympathize with the little uncle, who is bound to a heavenly marriage by a mortal like you."
Unexpectedly, they have only met twice, so it can be said that they are strangers to each other.
But Lan Xin was targeting her so much that Zhao Hao Ning was so angry that she wanted to throw an emoji at her face, while Zhong Lizui shouted in a deep voice: "That's enough."
"I have no elders. Is this your upbringing as a disciple of the Wentian Sect?" Zhongli Sui looked at Lan Xin with deep eyes: "What you said today, I will tell your master, Elder Tang, the truth when I return to the Wentian Sect."
"Disciple Lan Xin, you will be grounded in Guiyun Inn today. After I investigate the demon clan in Guiyun City, I will lift the grounding according to the situation." Zhong Lizui's words could not be refused: "Receive the punishment yourself."
"Uncle Junior..." Lan Xin, who didn't expect that she would be punished, turned green with anger.
She wanted to say something else, but Zhong Lizui had already pulled Zhao Hao Ning out of Guiyun Inn.
"Junior Sister Lan, please." Wan Yougan was supervising Lan Xin's confinement.
While being urged by Wan Youqian, Lan Xin complained dissatisfiedly: "I'm right, we can't help the 10-star demon this time, and Zhao Hao Ning, a mortal, is just a drag."
[Host, that Lan Xin is targeting you very much. It seems that he is targeting you because of Zhongli Sui]
"Yes, so Zhong Lisuo attracted me enemies, so can Lan Xin give me points for targeting me?" Zhao Hao Ning asked nonchalantly.
[Host, it must be Zhongli Jue himself who hates you in order to add points]
[And host, can you figure out the key point? Lan Xin is targeting you because of Zhongli Sui. Do you think Lan Xin is Zhongli Sui’s rotten peach blossom? 】
Hearing the system's guiding suspicion, Zhao Hao Ning sneered: "You are blind, what kind of rotten peach blossom can she be? She is pure hatred."
【Huh? Who does she hate? Does she hate you because you are Zhong Lizui's fiancée? 】
"I have already said that she is pure hatred, not only for me but also for Zhongli Sui." Zhao Hao Ning was determined.
Although she didn't know why Lan Xin hated herself, from how Lan Xin targeted her just now, Zhao Hao Ning clearly felt that Lan Xin hated her as if he wanted to kill her.
Moreover, Zhao Haining not only felt Lan Xin's targeting of herself, but also Lan Xin's targeting and hatred of Zhong Lizui.
